title: Very thin and overpriced. You shouldn't have to pay over $100 for a towel set that is really nice.
text: Very thin and overpriced. You shouldn't have to pay over $100 for a towel set that is really nice.. The clue in the company's description is that they are "lightweight" so they dry fast.  I guess thin/lightweight was actually a true description.  Luckily I bought these for the color they are so I could match them to a wild multi-color shower curtain I purchased.  The color does match, but I'll likely only use the hand towels because they are so intense.  They won't be used as an actual towel for the shower.
